newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Builder HBG's order book up 13 pct at Dfl 5.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Builder HBG's order book up 13 pct at Dfl 5.2 bln.

text.p: Dutch builder and dredger HBG said on Tuesday it had boosted its order book by 13 percent in the first half to 5.2 billion guilders.

"Our order book is better than in the first half of last year (4.6 billion guilders), and turnover is also up slightly on 1995 despite the heavy winter," chairman Nic de Ronde Bresser told a news conference on the 1996 first-half results.
HBG, the Netherlands' largest builder, earlier reported net profit from ordinary operations jumped 17 million guilders to 57 million on turnover up 100 million at 2.71 billion guilders.
However the year-on-year turnover comparison was slightly skewed by the construction sector strike which depressed output in the 1995 first half, De Ronde Bresser said.
"In both years we were able to catch up (on the strike in 1995 and the cold winter in 1996) reasonably well in the second half," he added.
HBG is forecasting full-year net profit will be slightly higher than last year's 104 million guilders.
